verdict.rationale: Zamzar is a cloud file-conversion service and API, so event-driven automation rules are a fair axis for it. The evidence only shows on-demand conversion jobs, polling until a job completes, and an optional 'Email when done?' notification. None of these is a user-definable rule that triggers actions on events, so the email toggle counts only as an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
